conventions: Every new .ts, .tsx, or .js file must start with the 2026 Apache-2.0 license header (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors); never alter the copyright year in existing files.
Formatting uses Prettier with singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'all', arrowParens: 'avoid', and 80-column print width.
Public exports in @backstage/* packages must carry TSDoc comments with a release tag (@public or @alpha) and stay in sync with each package's report*.api.md file.

Frontend user-facing strings must be registered in the plugin's createTranslationRef messages object (catalogTranslationRef in plugins/catalog/src/alpha/translation.ts and techdocsTranslationRef in plugins/techdocs/src/translation.ts) and read with useTranslationRef.
Tests use Jest and @testing-library/react with renderInTestApp and TestApiProvider from @backstage/test-utils.

decisions.topic: Former-names annotation constant, syntax, and validation
decisions.choice: Export @public ANNOTATION_FORMER_NAMES = 'backstage.io/former-names' from @backstage/catalog-model; value is a comma-separated list of entity names or references ([<kind>:][<namespace>/]<name>) resolved against the declaring entity's own kind and metadata.namespace (or 'default'), restricted to the same kind and excluding self-references.
rejected: Dedicated metadata.formerNames array field on the Entity envelope
decisions.reason: Well-known annotations require no Entity schema migration, and restricting claims to the same kind prevents cross-kind URL hijacking.

decisions.topic: Backend persistence and indexing of former entity refs
decisions.choice: Index normalized lowercase former entity refs (kind:namespace/name) in the existing search table under key FORMER_NAME_SEARCH_KEY = 'formerrefs' inside buildEntitySearch.
rejected: Adding a new entity_former_refs SQL table and migration
decisions.reason: The search table already has ON DELETE CASCADE from final_entities, composite index (key, value, entity_id), atomic sync during performStitching via syncSearchRows, and automatic reuse in InMemoryCatalogClient.

decisions.topic: Precedence, conflict resolution, and permission enforcement
decisions.choice: In DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef and InMemoryCatalogClient.getEntityByFormerRef, a live entity in final_entities matching the requested ref always takes precedence; if no live entity exists at that ref, query search rows with key 'formerrefs' and value equal to the normalized ref (limit 2), returning the entity only when exactly 1 live entity claims it and returning undefined when 0 or >=2 live entities claim it; AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef enforces catalogEntityReadPermission (including conditional permission predicates) on the resolved entity.
rejected: First-come-first-served or lexicographical tie-breaking on conflicting former-name claims
Mutating GET /entities/by-name/:kind/:namespace/:name to return a differently named entity
decisions.reason: Returning undefined on >=2 claimants prevents silent hijacking on ambiguous claims, and keeping GET /entities/by-name exact preserves zero extra query cost on direct hits.

decisions.topic: OpenAPI route and CatalogApi lookup contract
decisions.choice: Add GET /entities/by-former-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name} (operationId: GetEntityByFormerName) to plugins/catalog-backend/src/schema/openapi.yaml, regenerate OpenAPI server/client code via yarn generate in plugins/catalog-backend, wire router.get('/entities/by-former-name/:kind/:namespace/:name') in createRouter.ts with entity-fetch auditing (queryType: 'by-former-name'), and expose getEntityByFormerRef(entityRef, options) on CatalogApi, CatalogClient, InMemoryCatalogClient, and catalogApiMock.
rejected: Overloading queryEntities filter predicates in frontend hooks without a dedicated CatalogApi method
decisions.reason: A dedicated endpoint and CatalogApi method encapsulates precedence, conflict detection, and permission checks on the backend while keeping direct getEntityByRef calls untouched.

decisions.topic: Frontend redirect and dismissible notice state in Catalog and TechDocs
decisions.choice: On a direct getEntityByRef miss in useEntityFromUrl (catalog) and useExternalRedirect (techdocs), call catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.(entityRef); if a renamed entity is returned, navigate with { replace: true, state: { ...location.state, redirectedFrom: requestedRef } } preserving sub-route path, search, and hash, and render a dismissible MUI Alert (severity='info') when location.state.redirectedFrom is set.
rejected: Passing redirectedFrom via URL query parameters
Module-level global state for redirect notices
decisions.reason: React Router location.state keeps the canonical redirected URL clean while surviving the replace navigation and scoping the notice to the redirected history entry.
